name: Cormac Duffy
brief_description: a well-fed man dusted in flour

home.name: The Mill
home.description: A sturdy stone mill built beside a weir on the stream. The great wooden wheel turns slowly in the current. Sacks of grain and flour are stacked against the walls. The air is thick with white dust. It is daylight. The weather is weather.

workplace.name: The Mill
workplace.description: A sturdy stone mill built beside a weir on the stream. The great wooden wheel turns slowly in the current. Sacks of grain and flour are stacked against the walls. The air is thick with white dust. It is daylight. The weather is weather.

source_personality_summary: The prosperous miller who controls the only mill in the parish.
source_knowledge: Knows exactly how much grain every farm in the parish produces — and what they owe.
Has been quietly buying up IOUs from struggling farmers, building leverage.
Heard that the landlord may sell the estate, which could mean new terms for everyone.
Knows the stream level is dropping — a dry summer could stop the mill wheel.

source_schedule_cues.activity: at the crossroads after Mass, talking business despite the day
at Darcy's Pub for a drink, keeping his ear to the ground
attending Mass at St. Brigid's in his good coat
at Connolly's Shop, discussing prices and supplies with Roisin
walking about the village, surveying his standing
Sunday dinner at home — Nora's best cooking
afternoon milling, weighing sacks, settling accounts
dinner at the mill house with Nora and Brendan
grinding grain — oats, barley, whatever the farmers bring
home to the mill house for the night
rising early, checking the mill wheel and the sluice
sleeping at the mill — even the wheel rests on Sunday
